domain: Domain X is tagged Sentence(Tree,ordered frames,aligned anchors), or finite Spread action trace starting at default state. Sentence requires valid cached Tree child indices and in-range predicate anchors, with anchors[i] belonging to frames[i]. For frame i, row=i+1; append copula-no-who iff Fact Is/IsA or non-Bare verb be lacks agent, time-in-where iff time_word(place.id,place.named), and who-is-what iff equal nonempty ASCII-case-insensitive agent/patient IDs survive reflexive and both-bare exclusions. Then each unsaid slot uses its aligned predicate's first unused qualifying child; Agent accepts passive OblAgent or nonpassive Nsubj, Patient NsubjPass or non-time Obj, Recipient Iobj; other slots abstain. Spread appends only VerbNet/nonempty-signature frames to key (verb,signature), class, ordered (id,i+1) occurrences. counts=(number of keys,number of keys with >1 class). Winner per key is lexicographically smallest class among maximal occurrence counts; hits emits every losing occurrence in key/class order and within-class insertion order.
state: Sentence hits preserve 1-based frame row association; anchors and token indices stay zero-based and are never substituted for frame row numbers. Missing anchor/predicate suppresses only unsaid-own. Any anchored-role use excludes that token for all unsaid slots; reflexives and both-bare unresolved identities exclude who-is-what. Multiple hits per row and repeated unsaid slots are possible. Spread counts occurrences, including repeated add calls/IDs; no deduplication or absolute majority is required. Single-class groups have no losers, ties choose smaller class and different verb/signature keys never share a winner.
